input: Check my order BB-1022 and also tell me how to descale the DB-12.

meta.note: claude-haiku-5-5, one trial, run by OpsDesk

output:
Hi, here's an update on both questions.

Order BB-1022: This order was delivered on 31 October 2026 via ParcelPost (tracking PP1022027731). It contains 1 x Vanilla Syrup 750 ml and 1 x Brightside Descaler 1 L, with a total of $39.45.

Descaling the DB-12 Drip Brewer: Run a descale cycle once a month. Mix 1 litre of Brightside Descaler with 1 litre of water, run it through the brewer, then run two full cycles of plain water. Wash the basket and carafe after each use as well.

Note that the warranty does not cover failures caused by not descaling, so keeping up with this helps protect your machine. If you see error code H1 after unplugging the unit for 10 minutes, contact support.
